rows.query: What is the foreclosure charge if I close the loan early?

top.title: Can I prepay or foreclose my loan
top.content: Yes. You can foreclose the loan after paying 6 EMIs. A foreclosure charge of 4% of the outstanding principal applies. Part-prepayment is allowed once a year up to 25% of the outstanding principal with a 2% charge on the prepaid amount.

rows.query: What is the penalty for a missed EMI?

top.title: What happens if I miss an EMI
top.content: A late payment charge of 2% per month is levied on the overdue instalment amount, plus a cheque or NACH bounce charge of Rs. 500 per instance. Missed monthly instalments are reported to credit bureaus and can lower your credit score.

rows.query: What happens if I miss my premium payment, will the policy lapse?

top.title: Grace Period and Lapse
top.content: There is a 31-day grace period after the premium due date. If the premium is still unpaid after the grace period, the policy lapses and coverage stops. A lapsed policy can be reinstated within 2 years by paying the back premiums and submitting a health declaration.
